oss.name: Grafana OSS
oss.classificationReason: OSS dashboards and alerting are AGPL. Commercial edition includes both enterprise administration and routine workflow extensions such as proprietary data-source integrations and reporting; conservative tier C, not feature-complete A.

health.rsx: Shared rsx analyze report available; no score used as license or feature evidence.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Replaces dashboarding/alerting workflow when paired with separately operated telemetry stores and collectors. Grafana alone is not a full Datadog APM/logs/security replacement; dashboards and alert rules require rebuilding.
HTTP/TCP/DNS/push checks, alert delivery and status pages. Operate your own external vantage points; no claim of Pingdom transaction or real-user-monitoring parity or check import.

Supports Sentry client SDKs for error and basic performance monitoring. Reconfigure DSNs and validate SDK compatibility; existing Sentry issue history, replay and advanced tracing migration not established.
Basic site availability pings, heartbeat checks and email/webhook alerts; partial uptime alternative, without established Pingdom browser transactions/RUM parity.
